text:
I understand you're in the middle of a move and it can be overwhelming! However, I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access your account information or make any changes. This is for your security and privacy.

Since you can't remember your email address right now, I can authenticate you using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide:

1. Your first name
2. Your last name  
3. Your zip code (your new Phoenix zip code would be great!)

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to help you update your address and look up information about t-shirts for you.
zh:
我理解你正在搬家，这可能让人不知所措！然而，在我能访问你的账户信息或进行任何更改之前，我需要先验证你的身份。这是为了你的安全和隐私。

由于你目前记不起电子邮件地址，我可以用你的名字和邮政编码来验证你。你能提供：

1. 你的名字
2. 你的姓氏 
3. 你的邮政编码（你新的凤凰城邮政编码会很好！）

一旦我验证了你的身份，我就能帮你更新地址，并为你查找T恤信息。
